title: Is this a silent bear market?

observed_trades.setup: Small short in the refiner with XLE closing as a bearish engulfing; it closed on the lows so he carried it overnight.
observed_trades.quote: I once again tried a little bit of VLO. This one closed um, on the lows basically. So, I was able to hold it into the overnight session
observed_trades.notes: Direction confirmed at 15:05 ('I picked up a little VLO short ... small position'). 'Once again tried' = a repeat attempt; earlier attempts not described. Would add if crude and the CRAK ETF come down.

observed_trades.setup: Long Micron from last Thursday; trimmed yesterday, uncomfortable with the price action.
observed_trades.stop: break of today's lows / 969 -> will cut more
observed_trades.quote: I'm not sitting here enjoying it, right? I bought my shares last Thursday
observed_trades.notes: Session is Thursday 2026-09-10, so 'last Thursday' = 2026-09-03. Ticker named in the same sentence at 07:13 ('I own Micron'). 969 is the level whose break triggers more selling (14:44).

observed_trades.setup: Trimmed some yesterday but wishes he had trimmed more.
observed_trades.quote: I own Micron um, and I did not trim enough yesterday
observed_trades.notes: 'I wish I would have done a little bit more of that yesterday, although I did a pretty good job' (14:55). Still holds ('I still have my Micron', 14:32).

observed_trades.setup: Short gold miners; thinks it goes at least back to the 200-day.
observed_trades.quote: I still have a short in GDX, which I have not covered any more of
observed_trades.notes: 'not covered any more' implies part already covered. Repeated at 15:05 ('I have a GDX short, which is working well').

observed_trades.setup: Breakout attempt in a leader at new 52-week highs, tiny size ahead of CPI.
observed_trades.stop: wanted to widen the stop but would not ahead of CPI
observed_trades.quote: and I bought like literally the tiniest sliver of Okta today.
observed_trades.notes: 174.57 is read off his platform at 13:59 right before 'and I closed it'; most likely the entry price but it could be the exit.

observed_trades.setup: Pushed, then faded; closed it rather than hold into CPI.
observed_trades.quote: in Octa. I'll tell you right now, yeah. 174.57 and I closed it basically into the end of day.
observed_trades.notes: 'I tried Octa today' (13:35). Exit price not clearly stated (see entry row for 174.57).

observed_trades.setup: Long from 36, letting it work while it stays above the 200 simple moving average.
observed_trades.stop: hold so long as it stays above the 200 simple moving average
observed_trades.quote: I also still have my I bet long from 36 bucks.
